data.exact_reserve_text: Estimate of cumulative GAAP gross claims incurred (referencing the table on page 20). We are closing the 2019 account with a loss of GBP 8.6m being 4.0% of stamp, which is slightly below the midpoint of the range of estimates we last indicated. This was, on the whole, due to some deterioration in the Contingency account's COVID-19 claims, as changing lockdown restrictions caused some rescheduled events to be rescheduled again or even finally cancelled where further rescheduling was no longer practical.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2021 calendar year, Blenheim Syndicate 5886 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 6.325 million, representing 3.50% of opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening primarily affected the 2017, 2018, and 2019 underwriting years. The 2019 underwriting year, which closed in 2021, contributed significantly to this adverse development, largely due to deterioration in the Contingency account's COVID-19 claims, as changing lockdown restrictions led to repeated rescheduling or cancellation of events.
